children: ICICI Securities's research report on Astral

For Q2FY27, Astral delivered in-line pipe volume growth of 19.1% YoY on a high base (10-year CAGR of 13.5%) as demand improved aided by uptrend in PVC resins prices. Pipe EBITDA/kg dipped 10.3% YoY to INR 31.2 due to adverse product mix and higher RM cost. India adhesives business revenue grew 25.3% YoY with margin of 10.9% (-610bps YoY) due to RM inflation. For FY27, management guides for double-digit pipe volume and OPM of ~16–18%; for India adhesive ~20% revenue growth and ~13% OPM. We believe profitability in both businesses should improve as RM inflation has been passed on. We tweak our estimates; retain BUY with a revised SoTP-based Sep’27E TP of INR 1,810.
We maintain our BUY rating with a revised SoTP-based Sep’27E TP of INR 1,810 (earlier INR 1,831).
